tasks.goal: Read app/users.py, app/handler.py, existing tests and README.md to learn the user data model, routing style, error handling conventions and test layout. Report findings; change nothing.
tasks.title: Survey users store and handler

tasks.goal: In app/users.py add list_users(search=None, page=1, page_size=10) that filters by username substring (case-insensitive unless conventions say otherwise), validates that page and page_size are positive integers (reject bools, non-ints, values < 1, and cap or reject an excessive page_size), raises the repo's existing error type on invalid input, and returns the requested slice of results in a stable order.
tasks.title: Add list_users with search and pagination

tasks.goal: In app/handler.py add a GET /users route that reads the search, page and page_size query parameters, converts page and page_size from strings to ints, calls list_users, returns the results as JSON, and maps validation errors (including non-numeric values) to a 400 response following the existing handler conventions.
tasks.title: Add GET /users route

tasks.goal: Add tests for list_users covering no search, substring match, no matches, first, middle and last pages, a page beyond the end, default arguments, and invalid page and page_size values (zero, negative, non-integer, bool). Follow the existing test layout.
tasks.title: Tests for list_users

tasks.goal: Add tests for the GET /users route covering the default response, search filtering, pagination parameters, and 400 responses for invalid or non-numeric page and page_size. Follow the existing handler test style.
tasks.title: Tests for GET /users route

tasks.goal: Write a short docs/USERS.md describing list_users and GET /users: parameters and defaults, search semantics, pagination and validation rules, the response shape, error responses, and one example request and response. It must match the implemented behavior.
tasks.title: Write docs/USERS.md

tasks.goal: Independently review the full diff for correctness, validation edge cases, test coverage and accuracy of docs/USERS.md against the code. Report structured findings; change nothing.
tasks.title: Review the change

intent.goal: Add search and pagination to the users store in app/users.py: list_users(search=None, page=1, page_size=10) filtering by username substring, validating page and page_size, plus a GET /users?search=&page=&page_size= route in app/handler.py, tests for both, and a short docs/USERS.md describing the API
